subject.title: [Feature] Re-enable dev channel distribution tag for npm releases

question: Should OpenClaw support a moving-main npm `dev` dist-tag, or should release-channel docs make dev installs git-only?
rationale: The source and registry gap is clear, but enabling the channel changes npm package distribution and supply-chain policy, so automation should not choose the permanent release/security boundary.

options.title: Retire npm dev selector
options.body: Update release-channel, installer, updater, and release docs so `dev` is explicitly git-based unless release owners later sponsor npm snapshots.

options.title: Design npm dev snapshots
options.body: Add a first-class secure publish path with versioning, approvals, provenance, credential boundaries, rollback, tests, and registry readback before enabling `openclaw@dev`.

options.title: Keep policy undecided
options.body: Leave this issue open as a release-owner decision while existing dev users continue using the git checkout path.

recommendation.title: Retire npm dev selector
recommendation.body: Update release-channel, installer, updater, and release docs so `dev` is explicitly git-based unless release owners later sponsor npm snapshots.
